name: When should I consider a primary bathroom addition versus remodeling my existing space?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a primary bathroom addition versus remodeling my existing space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a primary bathroom addition if your current home lacks the fundamental square footage or ideal location to achieve your desired spa-inspired retreat. If your primary goal is to gain space that cannot be accommodated within the existing footprint, an addition provides that opportunity. Remodeling your existing space is ideal when the current layout is functional, but the finishes, fixtures, and amenities are outdated or do not align with your aesthetic. AKN Design Group specializes in both comprehensive remodels and seamless additions, guiding you through the decision-making process to determine the best approach for your home and lifestyle needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a bathroom addition for new space where none exists, or a remodel to update finishes and features within your current footprint. We help you determine the best approach.
